audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows contradicted the page's own why text: level 3 and 4-5 were given to Gragas though whys[2] and whys[3] say you win both, level 6 was 'Skill' though whys[4] says 'Gragas reclaims 6', first item was Gragas though whys[5] calls it close, and 2+ items was Gragas though whys[6] says you out-DPS him.
audit.why: Flawless Duet at 3 gives Irelia the stun-into-reset pattern Gragas has no second dash to escape (Body Slam 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s); Explosive Cask at 6 knocks her out of melee.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-6 set to Irelia, Irelia, Gragas, Skill, Irelia in both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings — the same chart the mirror already applied.

audit.why: Spikes place level 3 (Flawless Duet), level 6 (Explosive Cask, 100/85/70s), the core-item peak and the two-item extended-fight edge; all four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly sells Defiant Dance as blocking Gragas's combo — 'W-block his E-Q burst', whys[5], spikes[2], late. Riot's text says Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage taken during the charge, and Gragas's Q, W, E and R are all magic damage, so it blunts none of it. Drunken Rage's auto-attack reset was never named as the burst tell.
audit.why: Building your all-in timing around a damage reduction that does not apply is the single most costly error on this page; the mirror flagged the same premise from Gragas's side.
audit.corrected: whys[5] and spikes[2] now say Defiant Dance cuts physical only and route the advantage to reset uptime and ramping on-hit instead; Key Ability Interactions names Body Slam's 14s cooldown as his only dash and Drunken Rage's 1-second sip as the reset tell.

edits.before: Your core-item spike — reset uptime and shred peak, and your W blocks his combo, but his sustain keeps him from dying through it, so it stays close.
edits.after: Your core-item spike — reset uptime and on-hit peak, but Defiant Dance cuts physical only and his kit is all magic, so his sustain keeps it close.

edits.before: Core-item spike: full Bladesurge reset uptime plus your passive armor/MR shred lets you out-DPS the brief damage-reduction window on his W (Drunken Rage).
edits.after: Core-item spike: full Bladesurge reset uptime plus your ramping on-hit out-damages Drunken Rage's reduction — it is a 5s cooldown, so he has it most trades.

edits.before: Track Gragas's Body Slam: His engage. Stun him when it’s down. When it is down — E-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Body Slam is 14s and his only dash; Drunken Rage's 1s sip is the auto-reset tell before his burst.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Barrel Roll grows stronger the longer the cask sits — leave early.

notes: Left in place but wrong for the same reason as the fixed lines: the full layer's tldr, winCon, report[0], report[1] and dosFull[1] all say 'W-block his E-Q burst', which Defiant Dance cannot do against an all-magic kit. Those strings are short and heavily cross-referenced, so rewriting them safely needs a decision on new phrasing — flagged rather than half-fixed.
